title: Common-stage descent of a finite family of specified arrows
statement: For a cofiltered affine-transition qcqs inverse system with limit c, fix finitely presented qcqs source and target models V_a,W_a over one stage. A finite family of arrows from the limit base changes of V_a to W_a, compatible with the base, descends to a single later stage, with equality to each original arrow after limit base change. Empty families are allowed. [def-pc-scheme] [pqf-def-affine-morphism] [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]

proof.text: Descend each arrow separately by 01ZM(2). A finite wide cospan in the cofiltered category gives one stage whose arrows commute with all maps to the original stage. Precompose each descended arrow with the induced pullback map. Pullback projection identities and cone naturality prove both required equalities.

theorem exists_finitePresentation_arrows_stage
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i : I)
    {κ : Type v} [Finite κ] (V W : κ → Scheme.{u})
    (pV : ∀ a, V a ⟶ D.obj i) (pW : ∀ a, W a ⟶ D.obj i)
    [∀ a, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (pV a)] [∀ a, QuasiCompact (pV a)]
    [∀ a, QuasiSeparated (pV a)]
    [∀ a, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (pW a)] [∀ a, QuasiCompact (pW a)]
    [∀ a, QuasiSeparated (pW a)]
    (ψ : ∀ a, pullback (pV a) (c.π.app i) ⟶ W a)
    (hψ : ∀ a, ψ a ≫ pW a = pullback.fst (pV a) (c.π.app i) ≫ pV a) :
    ∃ (j : I) (f : j ⟶ i) (θ : ∀ a, pullback (pV a) (D.map f) ⟶ W a),
      (∀ a, θ a ≫ pW a = pullback.fst (pV a) (D.map f) ≫ pV a) ∧
      ∀ a, pullback.map (pV a) (c.π.app i) (pV a) (D.map f)
        (𝟙 _) (c.π.app j) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp) ≫ θ a = ψ a
